items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: I ain't seen him yet... Pajou's dead now, eh? I say, he said, yeah... Pajou. Well, them musicians, they got the stuff with them.

ctx.x: Calliope, he can play that. Because I say, yeah. Well, he played with P. Roy and all of them. See? Now, of course, this fellow, yeah, they tell me, I ain't seen him yet. But I told my cousin Warnick that the old man will fit this Pajou's place will be Peter Bocard. And they tell me he's in the band.
Yeah, he's been playing with the Urican.
